job.title: Easy apply - Hybris Architect - Adept Solutions Inc.

tailoring.headline: SAP Hybris Architect | Senior Java & Spring Developer | SAP Commerce Cloud Expert
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering enterprise SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, microservices and OCC REST APIs. Proven record designing PIM/ERP/MDM integrations, data pipelines and CI/CD deployments on cloud platforms. Strong techno-functional consulting skills, stakeholder management and AI-assisted development. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with agile delivery experience.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Hybris Architect
cover_en.hook: I am excited by Adept Solutions’ reputation for delivering cutting-edge SAP Commerce architectures that drive digital transformation. With over five years of hands-on experience building and scaling Hybris platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am eager to bring that expertise to your team.

bullets.label: Architecture Design
bullets.text: Designed end-to-end SAP Commerce Cloud architectures, implementing Java/Spring services and OCC APIs that support high-volume B2B/B2C commerce.

bullets.label: API Integration
bullets.text: Led PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines and ERP/MDM integrations using DataHub, Hotfolders and custom OCC services, ensuring seamless product and customer data flow.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Leadership
bullets.text: Acted as a bridge between business and IT, gathering requirements, writing user stories and functional specs, and guiding international stakeholders through delivery.

bullets.label: CI/CD & Cloud Delivery
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2) with Docker and Kubernetes, enabling reliable cloud releases and rapid iteration.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, Germany, I hold a valid German work permit, am serving notice until 15 December 2026 and can start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute.

tailoring.why_company: Adept Solutions stands out as a leader in SAP Commerce Cloud innovation, consistently delivering complex, high-performance e-commerce architectures for global brands. Your focus on architect-driven, scalable solutions aligns perfectly with my passion for building robust Hybris platforms. I am drawn to your collaborative culture and commitment to leveraging emerging technologies, which would allow me to apply my SAP Hybris expertise to drive measurable business value for your clients.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to shape enterprise-grade SAP Commerce architectures at Adept Solutions, leveraging my proven Hybris expertise to drive scalable, integrated e-commerce solutions.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a SAP Hybris Architect with 5+ years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’m excited about the Hybris Architect role at Adept Solutions and would love to connect.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Hybris Architect – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body: Dear Hiring Team, please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Hybris Architect position at Adept Solutions. With over five years of hands-on experience designing and delivering SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) architectures for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am confident I can add immediate value. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit.
